editorial:
Imagine you are a kind teacher who just wants to help a kid get his life on track. That is exactly where you start with this story. You follow a woman who tries to be a mentor to a troubled high school student, thinking she is doing the right thing. However, the vibe quickly shifts from a helpful school drama to a scary thriller. You will feel the tension build as the student completely misreads her kindness for romantic interest, and things get dangerous very fast. It is a stressful watch that makes you wonder if being too nice can actually backfire.

The acting is solid and makes the danger feel real, though the plot moves a bit slowly in the middle. You will likely find yourself shouting at the screen for the teacher to just get away from him. If you enjoy movies about obsession and creepy situations, you should definitely give this a try. Since it is an older film, you might want to look for a remastered version. You can try renting it on Apple TV or adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality for your home theater setup.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the student's obsession turns into a full-blown attack. He tries to force the teacher into a relationship, leading to a violent struggle. In the final scenes, the teacher has to fight for her life to escape his grip. She eventually manages to overpower him, ending the nightmare. The movie wraps up by showing that her attempt to help a lost soul almost cost her everything.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers about dangerous obsessions.
